links.outcome: Reading grade level of existing pediatric neurosurgery patient education materials versus recommended 3rd-7th grade
links.effect: Existing materials exceeded recommended range: mean Flesch-Kincaid grade level 10.60 (SD 0.57) before AI modification.
links.quote: However, existing resources often exceed this range, hindering comprehension for many patients.

links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid grade level of patient education materials before and after ChatGPT plain-language rewriting
links.effect: ChatGPT reduced mean reading level from 10.60 (SD 0.57) to 6.18 (SD 0.28; p < 0.05), reaching the 6th-grade target across all conditions.
links.quote: ChatGPT effectively reduced the mean reading level from 10.60 (SD 0.57) to 6.18 (SD 0.28; p < 0.05), achieving the target 6th-grade level across all conditions.

links.effect: Mean reading level decreased from 10.60 (SD 0.57) to 6.18 (SD 0.28; p < 0.05).
